Installing a fixture plugin

description: The fixture install page, which carries the steps, the way onward
  and nothing that would move when the real catalogue address does.

A server installs plugins from a catalogue it is told about, and the address of
that catalogue is a value this page reads rather than a sentence written into
it.

The list below is computed from what each fixture repository has published, so
the page and the table it is reached from are one read of the same file.

onward: Every fixture plugin and what state it is in [/]

onward: What happens to a request for a fixture page [/privacy/]
